title: US judge blocks Trump's bid to redirect $1.3 billion in homelessness funding to temporary housing
summary_full: A federal judge ruled against the Trump administration's plan to change homelessness funding priorities. The judge determined the changes exceeded the authority granted to the Department of Housing and Urban Development. Additionally, the ruling requires the agency to reopen grant applications for organizations seeking funding support. HUD Secretary Scott Turner expressed dissatisfaction with the decision, citing potential disruptions to funding processes.
